fields.description: Issue includes investigative and opinion pieces on local civic and legal controversies, including allegations involving the Federal Savings & Loan Association and Harry Lipton in connection with Home Owners' Loan Corporation bonds and fees; discussion of Miami Beach traffic safety and calls for driver licensing; coverage of Hialeah municipal politics and predictions of Mayor G. C. Sparks' re-election; and reporting on tax-deed and foreclosure disputes involving W. H. Garrison and city tax liens. The paper also features the Miami Life "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest (winner: Miss Daisy Hanjaras of Grant Store), local social/gossip columns, and entertainment/sports items such as wrestling promotions.
